title: Unit transpose of the normalized completed-ring strict open exchange
statement: Let d be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let (v:U'→U,j':U'→T',j:U→T,g:T'→T) be a cartesian open square [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. Write R_V for the strict derived quotient reduction functor. For any K in D(Mod(d.completedRing U)), form omega_K as completedTowerPullback(g)(cbcRealizationReduction(j,K)) followed by cbcReductionStrictExchange(K) [def-cbc-completed-strict-open-exchange, def-cbc-completed-open-scalar-quotient-interface]. Under the actual open adjunction cbcRealizationTowerAdj(j'), the image of omega_K inverse is exactly CompletedOpenFiniteTranspose.unitArrow(K) [lem-cbc-completed-open-finite-transpose-coherence]. Explicitly this is the composite from completedTowerPullback(v)(R_U K) obtained by: the counit-normalized cbcDatumTowerTransport at v [def-cbc-completed-pullback-counit-transport]; v-pullback of the tower-open unit at R_U K; the inverse ringed pullback-square compositor at J_j(R_U K); and j'-pullback of g-pullback of the inverse quotient/open comparison followed by the inverse transport at g. This is an equality of morphisms in the derived category of strict completed-ring towers before evaluation, without completeness or quasi-compactness assumptions.

proof.text: Use the section formula defining cbcRightExchange and the explicit open adjunction of Tag 03DI. Transposition under the composite module adjunctions sends its inverse conjugate to pullback of the open unit followed by the inverse-image square compositor. This identifies the ordinary inverse-exchange map, including its coefficient action, not merely its isomorphism class.

proof.text: Transport both pullback presentations by cbcDatumTowerTransport. Naturality of adjunction transposition moves the inverse source quotient/open map through the right adjoint, producing precisely the final factor in unitArrow. The inverse source quotient/open comparison is cbcRealizationReductionInv by its definition; the other factors are the unit and square compositor from the preceding calculation.

theorem completedOpenStrictMateTranspose (sq : OpenImmersionSquare v j' j g)
    (K : d.derived U) :
    ((cbcRealizationTowerAdj d j').homEquiv _ _)
        ((completedTowerPullback g d).mapIso (cbcRealizationReduction d j K) ≪≫
          (cbcReductionStrictExchange d sq).app K).inv =
      CompletedOpenFiniteTranspose.unitArrow d sq K
